d.ko: West Hunt is a 1-8 player social deduction game set in the Old West! Among the hardworking townsfolk hides an Outlaw or two causing mischief and mayhem across town. Luckily, there are eagle-eyed Sheriffs ready to sniff them out! No matter what role you play, you're sure to have a hog-killin' time!

d.zh: 《西部对决》以美国旧西部为背景，是一款社交推理多人（1-4名玩家）游戏。
